differenceDefinitions.opencodeBehavior: OpenCode project skill projection and native event stream
differenceDefinitions.commonRequirement: One exact project instruction projection; duplicate roots deny admission
differenceDefinitions.hostSpecificAdaptation: Host-native discovery is observed through a closed projection

differenceDefinitions.opencodeBehavior: Selected native skill path with deny-by-default permissions
differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: No extensions and no native tools in the qualified profile
differenceDefinitions.hostSpecificAdaptation: Host-specific inventory is bounded before execution

differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: Native title plus advisory requests through the synthetic provider
differenceDefinitions.commonRequirement: No credential enters the host and provider shape is exact
differenceDefinitions.hostSpecificAdaptation: Adapter observes each host-native provider sequence

differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: Native Goose subagents rejected for this profile
differenceDefinitions.commonRequirement: No inherited or nested execution authority

differenceDefinitions.opencodeBehavior: Public KStack facade tested outside native advisory execution
differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: Goose MCP excluded from the selected profile
differenceDefinitions.commonRequirement: MCP cannot promote identity, authority, or host eligibility

differenceDefinitions.opencodeBehavior: OpenCode native permission events observed without authority transfer
differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: Goose tool proposal fails because the admitted tool inventory is empty
differenceDefinitions.commonRequirement: KStack remains the sole authority and broker owner

differenceDefinitions.opencodeBehavior: OpenCode config/data/cache/home roots isolated from the repository
differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: GOOSE_PATH_ROOT and HOME isolate Goose transient state
differenceDefinitions.hostSpecificAdaptation: Each adapter renders its native disposable-root layout

differenceDefinitions.opencodeBehavior: Deadline and process lifecycle observed through OpenCode execution
differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: GNU timeout and PID1 drain observe Goose cancellation
differenceDefinitions.commonRequirement: No orphan survives the bounded deadline
differenceDefinitions.hostSpecificAdaptation: Native termination forms normalize to the common lifecycle result

differenceDefinitions.opencodeBehavior: OpenCode cancellation events are adapter observations
differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: Goose process signal and timeout state are adapter observations
differenceDefinitions.commonRequirement: Cancellation never creates retry or authority
differenceDefinitions.hostSpecificAdaptation: Host-specific cancellation facts normalize at the boundary

differenceDefinitions.opencodeBehavior: Provider receipt ambiguity denies blind retry
differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: Effecting-provider ambiguity denies after one call
differenceDefinitions.commonRequirement: Possibly committed work is never retried blindly

differenceDefinitions.opencodeBehavior: OpenCode isolated state is disposable and non-authoritative
differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: Goose --no-session still writes only disposable transient state
differenceDefinitions.commonRequirement: No host session becomes KStack memory or durable authority
differenceDefinitions.hostSpecificAdaptation: Adapter binds the actual native transient-state behavior

differenceDefinitions.opencodeBehavior: No host memory route is admitted
differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: No Goose memory or resume route is admitted
differenceDefinitions.commonRequirement: Context cannot silently become durable cross-session state

differenceDefinitions.opencodeBehavior: Pinned OpenCode binary and active-set change require requalification
differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: Pinned reproducibly built Goose binary cannot self-update through the adapter
differenceDefinitions.commonRequirement: Host update invalidates evidence instead of inheriting support
differenceDefinitions.hostSpecificAdaptation: Each exact binary/source identity has a host-specific admission path

differenceDefinitions.gooseBehavior: Goose structured JSON and provider log facts are content-addressed
differenceDefinitions.commonRequirement: Only safe structured observations and content-free receipts persist
differenceDefinitions.hostSpecificAdaptation: Each adapter parses its native output without semantic substitution
